rabbi-chanina-ben-akavya.name: Rabbi Ḥanina ben Akavya
rabbi-chanina-ben-akavya.bio: Tanna whose rulings appear in the Mishna and in baraitot.
rabbi-chanina-ben-akavya.prompt: A thoughtful scholar in his 50s with a full dark beard streaked with grey and a plain wool mantle, one hand raised as if stating a ruling. Galilean limestone arches and olive trees softly behind him.
